title: Match YouTube hosts exactly instead of by substring
description: CodeQL py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts 17, 18, 19 in src/biblicus/url_text.py: YouTube detection used endswith on the network location so lookalike hosts such as notyoutube.com were treated as YouTube.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added features/url_source_classification.feature, which failed before the fix for notyoutube.com, notyoutu.be and YouTube.com:443. One helper, _is_youtube_hostname, does exact or dot-suffix hostname matching. Also fixed CodeQL notes: unnecessary lambda in context.py, import cycles between url_text and grobid_client (new url_text_errors.py) and between steering_proposals and taxonomy (new steering_models.py). The _ENSURED_URL alerts 23-25 are false positives because the variable is read.
